summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for leave-warning behavior, calculator ans chaining, GN covers, /web reader isolation, and WebGL representative titles.

critical.issue: Public preview still returns React SPA HTML (HTTP 200) instead of non-SPA failure response (expected 503/404 behavior for non-controlled service route).

ui_bugs.issue: Reader link interaction path is broken: inline script execution is blocked by CSP inside srcdoc, so in-frame navigation hooks cannot run.

integration_issues.issue: Example Domain content loads and no bundle.js request is made, but console shows CSP inline-script violation and reader cannot be proven to navigate via in-frame link click.

Injected first-endpoint WebSocket failure did not surface attempt rows in UI (status reached Connected·2, attempts list empty), so deterministic failover observability is still not exposed in current UI.

Games boot and create WebGL2 contexts, but multiple runtime errors persist (e.g., slope: 'Uncaught ReferenceError: e is not defined'; 3D-flight-simulator: missing script references/shader compile errors/404 assets).

issues: Reader footer message is present and clear.
No layout overflow at 320/768/1024/1440 in calculator view.

action_items: Fix reader srcdoc script/CSP nonce mismatch so in-frame link navigation posts messages correctly.
Fix /browse/service/* production route behavior to avoid SPA fallback on service path.
Add deterministic failover telemetry/UI state for first-fail second-success endpoint proof.
Investigate WebGL title-specific runtime errors (Unity JS exception, missing scripts/assets, shader compile failures) without relaxing sandbox policy.
critical_code_review_comments: reader.js forbids nonce in DOMPurify then injects CSP nonce-based inline script; resulting srcdoc contains inline script without nonce and gets blocked.
Game iframe intentionally omits allow-same-origin for app-origin srcDoc which protects isolation but prevents deep frame introspection from parent tests.
Render build exists and compiles, but large chunks remain (>1MB gzipped) and should be optimized separately.
seed_data_creation: No new seeded DB data created; only transient API reads/GET content calls and UI interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend full suite: 17 passed, 1 failed (/browse/service SPA fallback). Calculator ans flows now pass for 2+3=>5, ans+2=>7, plus negative/fractional chaining. /api/games returns 300 with 158 covers and local PNG map count matches 158. Reader mode loads example.com and avoids bundle.js fallback, but CSP blocks inline script so in-frame link navigation cannot be validated and likely broken. WebGL contexts initialize in tested titles, yet runtime/content-specific errors remain (Unity exceptions, missing scripts, shader errors).
rca of the issue: Primary RCA: In reader.js, DOMPurify FORBID_ATTR includes 'nonce', then CSP in srcdoc requires script nonce, but injected script loses nonce and is blocked (console CSP violation), breaking click-to-navigate messaging. Secondary RCA: /browse/service route on preview returns SPA HTML 200, indicating fallback boundary still allows app shell on service path. WebGL RCA: failures are content/runtime-specific (Unity build errors, missing assets, shader compile issues), not a blanket browser WebGL unavailability; contexts are created successfully in Chromium headless run.
